result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but horizontal carousel content is visibly cut off at the right edge and the lower restaurant card is obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category row ends with an unexplained partial gray pill at the far right, making the horizontal scrolling affordance look clipped rather than intentional.
issues.suggestion: Add a clear edge fade, spacing, or a visible portion of the next category label to indicate that the category list is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The third item in the “Fastest near you” carousel is cut off by the right viewport edge, including its restaurant name and delivery information.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearer carousel treatment such as an edge gradient or increase the visible card width/spacing so the partial next item feels intentional.

issues.description: The second card in “Popular right now” continues underneath the bottom navigation bar and is visually hidden by it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the scrollable content has sufficient bottom padding or a safe-area inset so cards can be viewed fully above the fixed navigation.
